test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word which means the same as the group of words given.**

Breathe hard and with difficulty
solution: The correct answer is '**Pant**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Pant**'. • It means** 'to breathe quickly in a labored manner, for example after running or because it is very hot'.** [हाँफना (जैसे दौड़ने के बाद या गरमी के मारे)] • *Example: He came in **panting** after running up the steps.*** Correct Answer:__** *Pant.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Strangle**: to kill somebody by squeezing his/her neck or throat with your hands, a rope, etc. [(हाथ, रस्‍सी आदि से) गरदन या गला घोंट कर किसी को मार देना] • **Choke**: to be or to make somebody unable to breathe because something is stopping air from getting into the lungs. (दम घुटना या घोटना) • **Cough**: to send air out of your throat and mouth with a sudden loud noise, especially when you have a cold, have something in your throat, etc. (गले, मुँह आदि से अचानक ज़ोर की आवाज़ के साथ वायु बाहर निकालना विशेषकर जब ज़ुकाम हो गया हो; खाँसना) 38:Ta9c, The correct answer is **'shall we'.**
